name: deadman
summary: Raises one alarm when a scheduled job has quietly stopped, by checking that it keeps proving it is alive.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (heartbeats and alarms go under $HUBKIT_HOME/state)
env.HUBKIT_NOTIFY_CMD: optional command run as: CMD "<title>" "<reason>" when an alarm fires
env.DEADMAN_NOW: tests only: epoch seconds that replace the clock
